verdict.rationale: The framework's documented outbound telephony lets agents place phone calls via outbound SIP trunks, which is the building block for a campaign. Nothing in the pack shows batch campaign management, scheduling, or throughput/concurrency controls, so the founder would have to build that orchestration layer themselves. Missing for 10: batch campaign/dialer functionality, call scheduling, throughput/rate or concurrency controls, independent corroboration of outbound calling at scale.
